newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian Banque du Sud to raise capital.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian Banque du Sud to raise capital.

text.p: Tunisian Banque du Sud said it has decided to raise its capital to 100 million dinars from 75 million dinars.
The bank said in a statement received on Monday that 22 million dinars would be raised in fresh cash and three million dinars through incorporation of reserves.
Date for the rise was not yet released.
BS's net profit in 1996 amounted to 10.3 million dinars, up from 9.7 million dinars in 1995.
The bank on Monday started distributing a 0.5 dinar or 10 percent dividend.
BS in 1996 raised its capital to 75 million dinars from 50 million dinars. Reserves at end of 1996 amounted to 21.1 million dinars.
The state-controlled bank has among its shareholders Italian bank Monte Dei Paschi Di Siena.
